Matrix Powerbank 10000mAh with Mobile Stand – Fast Charging Power Bank with Adjustable Phone Holder

The Matrix Powerbank 10000mAh with Mobile Stand is a smart, high-performance charging solution designed for users who need power, convenience, and versatility in one compact device. Built with an A grade lithium battery, this power bank ensures long-lasting performance, enhanced safety, and consistent charging efficiency for smartphones, wireless earbuds, smartwatches, and other USB-powered devices. With its 10000 mAH capacity, it provides sufficient backup power for daily use, travel, office, and outdoor activities.

What makes this power bank stand out is its integrated adjustable phone holder with an extendable height holder, allowing you to comfortably watch videos, attend video calls, or browse while your device charges. This dual-purpose design eliminates the need for a separate stand, making the Matrix Powerbank 10000mAh with Mobile Stand a practical choice for modern users who value functionality and portability.

Fast Charge Technology with Multiple Output Options

Equipped with fast charge support, this power bank delivers stable and efficient power output for compatible devices. It features 3 cable output (DC5V/ 2.4A) for direct charging convenience, along with 1 USB output (DC5V/ 2.4A) to connect additional devices. Whether you are charging Android phones, iPhones, Bluetooth speakers, or other gadgets, the Matrix Powerbank 10000mAh with Mobile Stand ensures reliable performance without overheating or power loss.

For recharging the power bank itself, it includes 1 USB cable input (DC5V/ 2.4A) and input micro (DC5V/ 2.4A), offering flexibility to recharge using different cables and adapters. This makes it compatible with most chargers available at home, in offices, or while traveling.

LED Indicator Battery Display for Easy Monitoring

The built-in LED indicator battery display provides real-time information about the remaining power level. This feature helps users plan charging cycles effectively and avoid unexpected power shortages. With clear and visible indicators, you always know when it’s time to recharge your Matrix Powerbank 10000mAh with Mobile Stand.

Premium Build with A Grade Lithium Battery

Designed using an A grade lithium battery, this power bank offers superior durability, improved charging efficiency, and extended battery life compared to standard power banks. The advanced battery technology ensures stable voltage output, enhanced safety protection, and consistent performance even after multiple charge cycles. This makes the a dependable accessory for both personal and professional use.

Ideal for Travel, Office, and Everyday Use

With its compact form factor and multifunctional design, this 10000 mAH power bank easily fits into backpacks, handbags, or laptop bags. The adjustable phone holder and extendable height holder make it especially useful for travelers, content viewers, students, and professionals who rely on their devices throughout the day. Whether you are commuting, working remotely, or attending online meetings, the Matrix 10000mAh with Mobile Stand keeps your devices powered and positioned comfortably.

Key Features & Specifications

  • High-capacity Matrix Powerbank 10000mAh with Mobile Stand
  • 10000 mAH long-lasting battery backup
  • Built-in adjustable phone holder with extendable height holder
  • Fast charge support for efficient power delivery
  • Premium A grade lithium battery for safety and durability
  • LED indicator battery display for real-time power status
  • 3 cable output (DC5V/ 2.4A) for multiple device charging
  • 1 USB output (DC5V/ 2.4A) for universal compatibility
  • 1 USB cable input (DC5V/ 2.4A) for convenient recharging
  • Input micro (DC5V/ 2.4A) support

If you are searching for a reliable, feature-rich, and user-friendly power solution, the is an excellent choice. Combining fast charging, smart design, and premium battery quality, it delivers outstanding value and performance for everyday power needs.
